snippet.title: Bumper Bout Feature Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938260/Bumper_Bout/

Bumper Bout is a PvP pinball party game that sees players directly compete with a shared playfield and balls. A heap of stages with unique mechanics and a cast of characters with powerful super attacks make this a shared screen showdown that’s easy to pick up and hard to put down!
